sources.title: GitHub - Nozomi01/TripoSG
sources.snippet: TripoSG is an advanced high-fidelity, high-quality and high-generalizability image-to-3D generation foundation model. It leverages large-scale rectified flow transformers, hybrid supervised training, and a high-quality dataset to achieve state-of-the-art performance in 3D shape generation.

sources.title: Pegasus · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pegasus is an encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) transformer model pretrained on unlabeled text to perform abstractive summarization. Pegasus is trained jointly on two self-supervised objective functions, masked language modeling (MLM) and gap sentence generation (GSG).
